title: MyGO and Ave Mujica Anime Sequel Reveals January 8, 2027 Release Date
content:
The upcoming anime sequel to MyGO and Ave Mujica, titled MyGO and Ave Mujica MyGO and Ave Mujica, revealed a January 8, 2027 release date. A teaser video was also released mainly featuring the cast of Ave Mujica. The video also announces Ave Mujica’s 8th live “Discrimen Fati,” which is held on May 29-30, 2027 at K-Arena.

BanG Dream! MyGO!!!!! // Ave Mujica is a sequel to BanG Dream! It’s MyGO!!!!! and Ave Mujica: The Die is Cast , which were both animated by studio Sanzigen and directed by Kodai Kakimoto . The voice cast includes:

• Hina Youmiya as Tomori Takamatsu

• Kanon Takao as Sakiko Togawa/Oblivionis

• Rin Tateishi as Anon Chihaya

• Mika Kohinata as Soyo Nagasaki

• Yuzuki Watase as Mutsumi Wakaba/Mortis

• Coco Hayashi as Taki Shina

• Rico Sasaki as Uika Misumi/Doloris

• Hina Aoki as Rana Kaname

• Akane Yonezawa as Nyamu Yutenji/Amoris

• Mei Okada as Umiri Yahata/Timoris

• Hazuki Tanda as Mana Sumita

Muse Asia is streaming both BanG Dream! It’s MyGO!!!!! and Ave Mujica: The Die is Cast . They describe the former as follows: “Would you play in a band for your whole life?” Late spring of the first year of high school. Everyone at Haneoka Girls’ High School is in a band. Anon, who enrolled in school late, rushes to find band members so she can fit in with her classmates as soon as possible. While at it, she learned that Tomori, the “Haneoka’s Weirdo Girl”, has not yet formed a band. And then, Anon calls on her… The scream of our music may be covered in scars and ill-formed. Even if we get lost, just move forward.
author: Anime Corner

title: Date A Live F Last Date Anime Film Key Visual and Trailer Revealed, Gets March 26, 2027 Premiere Date
content:
DATE A LIVE F Last Date anime film revealed a new key visual and trailer, along with a March 26, 2027 theatrical release date in Japan. The project was first announced in April without a specified format. The project is described as a completely new anime continuing the main Date A Live story as Shido Itsuka and the Spirits enter the final stage of their battle. The teaser features the tagline: “Now, let us begin our final war, our final date.”

Junji Nishimura is directing the anime, with Fumihiko Shimo writing the screenplay. Naoto Nakamura serves as character designer, while studio Fugaku is in charge of the animation production. ANIMEC is distributing the film. You can watch the trailer below.

You can also see the key visual below:

About Date a Live

Koshi Tachibana wrote the Date a Live novel series, which was serialized by Fujimi Shobo with Tsunako’s illustrations from 2012 to 2020 with a total of 22 volumes. A TV anime adaptation premiered in 2013, animated by AIC PLUS+ and directed by Keitaro Motonaga. Subsequent seasons were produced by different studios, including Production IMS, J.C. Staff, and GEEKTOYS, which animated the last two seasons. Kurumi Togisaki was voted the Best Girl of Spring 2024 , with Tohka in 7th place. Date a Live V also took the Spring 2024 awards for both the opening and ending theme songs , best ship or couple , best boy , as well as the main seiyuu awards .

Yen Press is publishing the Date a Live light novel series in English, while Crunchyroll streams the anime. They describe the story: Ordinary high school boy Shido discovers a mysterious girl at ground zero of a recent spacequake. Shido learns, through his sister Kotori, that the girl is one of the Spirits: mystical creatures responsible for the spacequakes. Shido is recruited to help “seal” the sprits and end their threat to mankind. There’s just one catch: the only way to seal a spirit—is to make her fall in love with you.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Kimi to Boku no Saigo no Senjou, Aruiwa Sekai ga Hajimaru Seisen' Season 3 in Production
content:
The Fantasia Bunko Daikanshasai 2026 event announced a third season for the Kimi to Boku no Saigo no Senjou, Aruiwa Sekai ga Hajimaru Seisen ( Our Last Crusade or the Rise of a New World ) anime series on Sunday, revealing the main staff, cast, and a teaser visual (pictured).

Staff Director, Series Composition: Yuki Inaba ( Kimi to Boku no Saigo no Senjou, Aruiwa Sekai ga Hajimaru Seisen Season II ) Character Design: Kaori Yoshikawa ( Kaminaki Sekai no Kamisama Katsudou ) Studio: Studio Palette , Silver Link.

Cast Iska: Yuusuke Kobayashi ( Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu ) Aliceliese Lou Nebulis IX: Sora Amamiya ( Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku wo! ) Mismis Klass: Nao Shiraki ( Yakusoku no Neverland ) Nene Alkastone: Kaori Ishihara ( Sword Art Online: Alicization ) Jhin Syulargun: Shunichi Toki ( Jibaku Shounen Hanako-kun ) Rin Vispose: Yumiri Hanamori ( Gachiakuta ) Sisbell Lou Nebulis IX: Azumi Waki ( Shangri-La Frontier )

The first season, adapting Kei Sazane 's action fantasy light novel , aired in 12 episodes in Fall 2020. Funimation simulcasted the first season with subtitles and subsequently streamed an English dub, releasing it on home video in November 2021.

The second season originally premiered in Summer 2024 but postponed indefinitely following episode four to maintain production quality, restarting broadcast from episode one in Spring 2025. Crunchyroll streamed the second season with multiple subtitles and dubs, releasing it on home video on September 8.

Sazane began penning the light novel, abbreviated as KimiSen , with illustrations by Ao Nekonabe under the Fantasia Bunko imprint in May 2017. Kadokawa published the 16th volume in October 2024.

Young Animal serialized a manga adaptation by okama ( Himawari! ) from May 2018 to March 2021. Hakusensha published the seventh and final volume in April that year.

Yen Press licensed both the light novel and manga adaptation in English in February 2019. The 16th novel volume went on sale on July 26. The seventh manga volume shipped in October 2023.

title: Our Last Crusade or the Rise of a New World Anime Gets 3rd Season, Reveals Returning Cast & Staff
content:
The " Fantasia Bunko Grand Thanksgiving Festival 2026 Online" event on Sunday revealed that a third anime season for Kei Sazane and Ao Nekonabe 's Our Last Crusade or the Rise of a New World ( Kimi to Boku no Saigo no Senjō, Arui wa Sekai ga Hajimaru Seisen ) light novel series is in the works, and also revealed a teaser visual and the returning cast and staff members from the second season.

The returning cast members are:

• Yūsuke Kobayashi as Iska

• Sora Amamiya as Aliceliese Lou Nebulis Ⅸ

• Nao Shiraki as Mismis Klass

• Kaori Ishihara as Nene Alkastone

• Shunichi Toki as Jhin Syulargun

• Yumiri Hanamori as Rin Vispose

• Azumi Waki as Sisbell Lou Nebulis Ⅸ

Yuki Inaba returns to direct the new season at Studio Palette and SILVER LINK. , and is also in charge of series scripts. Kaori Yoshikawa is again designing the characters.

The second season aired the first four episodes in July 2024, and then delayed episodes from its fifth episode onward in August 2024 "to maintain the quality" of the release. The season resumed airing from the first episode in April 2025. The second season was originally slated to air in 2023 but was delayed to July 2024. Crunchyroll streamed the season as it aired, and it is also streaming an English dub .

Yen Press is publishing the light novels and their manga adaptation in English, and it describes the story:

A great war has raged for years between the scientifically advanced Empire and Nebulis, the realm of magical girls—until the youngest knight ever to receive the title of the Empire's strongest meets the princess of the rival nation. Though they are sworn enemies, the knight is taken by her beauty and dignity, and the princess is moved by his strength and way of life. Will the fighting between them ever be allowed to end?

Kadokawa began publishing the novels in print in Japan in May 2017, and there are currently 16 volumes in print. Okama launched the manga adaptation in Hakusensha 's Young Animal magazine in May 2018, and the manga has a total of seven volumes. The Our Last Crusade or the Rise of a New World: Secret File spinoff light novel series currently has three volumes in print.

title: Date A Live F Last Date Anime Reveals Film Format, March 26, 2027 Opening in Teaser Video
content:
The " Fantasia Bunko Grand Thanksgiving Festival 2026 Online" event on Sunday revealed the anime film format and March 26, 2027 opening date for Date A Live F Last Date , the latest anime project for the Date A Live franchise . The announcement confirms the film is the "concluding arc" for the anime series. The event also revealed the film's teaser trailer, second teaser visual, and additional returning staff members.

Scriptwriter Fumihiko Shimo and character designer Naoto Nakamura , both from Date A Live IV and Date A Live V , return for the film. ANIMEC is distributing the film.

Junji Nishimura ( Vladlove , Extreme Hearts , Mechanical Marie ) is directing the anime at Fugaku .

Nobunaga Shimazaki , Marina Inoue , Misuzu Togashi , Ayana Taketatsu , Iori Nomizu , Asami Sanada , Maaya Uchida , Sarah Emi Bridcutt , Minori Chihara , Ayumi Mano , Hitomi Nabatame , Akari Kageyama , and Aya Endō all return from previous anime installments of the franchise to reprise their roles.

The Date A Live V television anime premiered in April 2024. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired and also streamed an English dub .

The first season of the Date A Live television anime adaptation aired 12 episodes and premiered in 2013. The second season aired 10 episodes and premiered in 2014. Funimation streamed the first and second seasons as they aired in Japan. The company also released the first season on Blu-ray Disc and DVD in June 2014 with an English dub , and released the second season on Blu-ray Disc and DVD in March 2016. The Gekijōban Date A Live: Mayuri Judgment anime film opened in Japan in August 2015.

The third season premiered in January 2019 and aired for 12 episodes. Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired, and Funimation offered a simuldub. The anime's fourth season premiered in April 2022. Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired, and it is also streaming an English dub . The anime was originally slated to premiere in October 2021, but was then delayed to April 2022 for "various reasons."

Koushi Tachibana launched the original light novel series in March 2011 with illustrations by Tsunako . Kadokawa 's Fantasia Bunko imprint published the 22nd and final volume in March 2020. Yen Press is releasing the novels in English.

The light novels have inspired several manga and video games.

Yuichiro Higashide 's Date A Live Fragment: Date A Bullet spinoff novels inspired a two-part theatrical anime adaptation in 2020.

Tachibana and Tsunako 's King's Proposal ( Ōsama no Propose ) light novel series has an anime adaptation in the works.
author: ANN

title: 'Akane-banashi 2nd Season' Reveals Additional Cast, Teaser Promo
content:
The special livestream presentation for the television anime adaptation of Yuuki Suenaga and Takamasa Moue 's Akane-banashi manga revealed a pair of additional cast, key visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video for the second season on Sunday. The anime series will begin airing on the IMAnimation programming block on TV Asahi's 24 affiliate stations, as well as BS Asahi and other stations in January 2027.

Voice actors Taku Yashiro ( Fumetsu no Anata e ) and Youji Ueda ( Sousou no Frieren ) are joining the cast as Asagao Konjakutei and Hassho Tsubakiya, respectively.

Ayumu Watanabe ( Summertime Render ) is returning to direct the second season at Zexcs , with Yuu Harima ( Cop Craft ) serving as assistant director. Other returning staff members include Michihiro Tsuchiya ( Cross Game ) handling the series composition, Kii Tanaka ( Zom 100 ) designing the characters and serving as chief animation director, Noriyoshi Konuma ( Gimai Seikatsu ) directing the sound, and Akio Izutsu composing the music.

Produced by Zexcs, the first season premiered on April 4. The anime streamed on YouTube in North and Latin America and on Netflix worldwide.

Suenaga and Moue began serializing the rakugo-themed drama manga in Weekly Shounen Jump in February 2022. Shueisha published the 24th volume on October 2. with the 25th volume planned for a December 4 release.

VIZ Media simulpublishes the manga in English and released the 17th volume on August 11. The 18th volume is set to be released on November 10. Shueisha's Manga Plus service also simulpublishes the manga in English, Spanish, Thai, and French.

title: Akane-banashi Season 2 Anime Reveals More Cast, Teaser Trailer
content:
TV Asahi revealed on Sunday a teaser trailer, key visual, and more cast for the second season of the television anime of writer Yūki Suenaga and illustrator Takamasa Moue 's Akane-banashi manga.

The new cast members include:

The new season will debut in January 2027.

TV Asahi describes the story of the second season ( Note: the below summary contains spoilers for the end of the first season ):

What you're about to experience is nothing less than the living history of Rakugo. Inspired by her Rakugoka father, Akane Osaki aims to become a Shin'uchi. After graduating high school, she formally joins Shiguma's school. Now known as Akane Arakawa, she takes her first steps as a Rakugoka. She arrives at Yasaka-tei, a traditional, bustling Rakugo theater. Surrounded by Shin'uchi, Akane finally begins her training at the heart of Rakugo performers. A full-fledged story of Rakugo, where master storytellers compete. The Zenza Arc begins!

New characters who appeared in the final episode of the first season and their cast members include:

• Hōchū Ōtsuka as Miroku Kashiwaya

• Ryōtarō Okiayu as Shomei Tsubakiya

• Hiroshi Naka as Enso Sanmeitei

• Mutsumi Tamura as Urara Ransaika

• Shinichirō Miki as Ryu'un Kenputei

• Tomokazu Seki as Chocho Konjakutei

The first season began airing on TV Asahi 's "IMAnimation" programming block on April 4, and ended in June with the conclusion of the show's Karaku Cup Arc. The anime also has its own " Akane-banashi Global" YouTube channel , where full episodes stream for free in North America and Latin America, after their television broadcast in Japan. Netflix debuted the English dub for the first two episodes on May 17 and launched later episodes weekly.

The anime is also streaming on aniverse in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. ADN is streaming it in France, Monaco, Andorra, Switzerland, Belgium, and Luxembourg. Anime Box is streaming it in Spain and Anime Generation is streaming it in Italy. The Ani-One YouTube channel is streaming the anime in the Asia Pacific (excluding Korea and China). Bahamut, ChungHwa Telecom MOD & Hami Video, LiTV & Ofiii, Line TV, My-Video , Catchplay, and friDay are streaming the anime in Taiwan. Bahamut is streaming it in Hong Kong and Macao. Catchplay is streaming it in Indonesia and TrueID is streaming it in Thailand. playmax.mn STAR TV is streaming it in Mongolia. Laftel and Aniplus Channel are streaming it in South Korea.

Ayumu Watanabe ( Children of the Sea , Fortune Favors Lady Nikuko ) directed the first season at ZEXCS . Yu Harima (episode director for Summer Time Rendering , Tokyo Revengers ) was the assistant director, and Kii Tanaka ( Cheating Craft , Hinomaru Sumo ) was both the character designer and chief animation director. Michihiro Tsuchiya ( PriPara , Cross Game ) oversaw the series scripts, and Akio Izutsu ( Phi-Brain - Puzzle of God , Akuma Kun ) composed the music. Kikuhiko Hayashiya was the rakugo supervisor.

Suenaga and Moue launched the manga in February 2022. Shueisha published the 24th compiled book volume on October 2. The manga was nominated for the 47th Kodansha Manga Awards and the 16th Manga Taisho awards in 2023. The manga ranked at #4 for the top 20 list of manga for male readers in the 2023 edition of Takarajimasha 's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! (This Manga Is Amazing!) guidebook.

Viz Media 's Shonen Jump service and Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service both publish the manga in English. Viz Media is also publishing the manga in print.
author: ANN

Suenaga and Moue launched the manga in February 2022. Shueisha published the 24th compiled book volume on October 2. The manga was nominated for the 47th Kodansha Manga Awards and the 16th Manga Taisho awards in 2023. The manga ranked at #4 for the top 20 list of manga for male readers in the 2023 edition of Takarajimasha 's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! (This Manga Is Amazing!) guidebook.
Viz Media 's Shonen Jump service and Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service both publish the manga in English. Viz Media is also publishing the manga in print.

title: Nigozyu Plans to End The Detective Is Already Dead Novels in 15th Volume
content:
Author nigozyu revealed in the 14th volume of their The Detective Is Already Dead ( Tantei wa Mō, Shindeiru. ) light novel series with illustrator Umibōzu on Friday they plan to end the series in the next novel volume.

Yen Press is publishing the original novels in English and describes the story:

When the story begins without its hero Kimihiko Kimizuka has always been a magnet for trouble and intrigue. For as long as he can remember, he's been stumbling across murder scenes or receiving mysterious attache cases to transport. When he met Siesta, a brilliant detective fighting a secret war against an organization of pseudohumans, he couldn't resist the call to become her assistant and join her on an epic journey across the world. …Until a year ago, that is. Now he's returned to a life that is normal and tepid by comparison, knowing the adventure must be over. After all, The Detective Is Already Dead .

Kadokawa published the first volume in the light novel series with illustrations by Umibōzu in November 2019 under Kadokawa 's MF Bunko J imprint. The novel won the 15th MF Bunko J newcomer award in 2019. Kadokawa published the 14th novel on Friday. Yen Press shipped the 12th novel in English on August 11.

The anime's first season premiered with a one-hour special in July 2021 and aired for 12 episodes. Funimation began streaming the anime in July 2021, and also streamed an English dub.

The second season debuted on October 7, and Crunchyroll is streaming the anime as it airs.

Hoko Hinachi and Minori Chigusa launched a new spinoff novel titled Charlotte wa Tada, Jiken o Tokitai. Tantei wa Mō, Shindeiru. Code:RED in May 2024. nigozyu is credited for the original work and as a supervisor for the novel.

Mugiko launched the manga adaptation of the main novels in Kadokawa 's Monthly Comic Alive magazine in May 2020, and ended it in October 2023. Kadokawa published the manga's sixth and final compiled book volume in October 2023.

title: Japan Honors Director Rintarō as Person of Cultural Merit
content:
Rintarō 's real name is Shigeyuki Hayashi . The director is currently 85 years old.

The director is in charge of the original story draft for Toei Animation 's new anime film based on Leiji Matsumoto 's Galaxy Express 999 franchise . He previously directed the 1979 Galaxy Express 999 film, the Adieu Galaxy Express 999 film, and the Galaxy Express 999: Emeraldas: The Eternal Warrior special.

He directed the silent film short " Yamanaka Sadao ni Sasageru Manga Eiga 'Nezumikozō Jirokichi' " ("Manga Cinema dedicated to Sadao Yamanaka ' NEZUMIKOZO JIROKICHI '"), his first directorial work in 14 years, and it screened at the 1st Niigata International Animation Film Festival in March 2023.

Aside from Galaxy Express 999 , Rintarō directed such works as Harmagedon , X/1999 , Space Pirate Captain Harlock , The Dagger of Kamui , Yona Yona Penguin , and Metropolis , and personally worked with Osamu Tezuka on Astro Boy , Kimba the White Lion , and Phoenix: Karma Chapter .

His autobiographical manga My Life in 24 Frames per Second ( 1-byō 24-koma no Boku no Jinsei ) launched in January 2024. It won the Grand Prize at the 29th Annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize awards. It was also nominated for Best Graphic Memoir in the 2026 Will Eisner Comic Industry Awards.

The honorees of Persons of Cultural Merit of 2025 included Masako Nozawa ( Dragon Ball 's Son Goku, Gegege no Kitarō 's Kitarō) as the first voice actor to be so honored, as well as manga creator Keiko Takemiya ( Toward the Terra , The Door into Summer , Andromeda Stories ), dancer and actor Min Tanaka ( Children of the Sea , live-action Rurouni Kenshin films), and playwright and actor Hideki Noda ("Tokatonton" anime short's narrator).

title: Crunchyroll Reveals English Dub Casts for Full Clearing Another World Under a Goddess with Zero Believers, 2 More Anime
content:
Crunchyroll began streaming the English dub for The Prince of Tennis II U-17 World Cup: Final Member Selection Match ( Shin Tennis no Ōji-sama U-17 World Cup Kesshō Member Ketteisen ), the sequel anime to The Prince of Tennis II: U-17 World Cup Semifinal ( Shin Tennis no Ōji-sama U-17 World Cup Semifinal ) anime, on Friday.

The company also began streaming the English dub for the second season of the television anime based on Nana Mikoshiba 's The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World ( Hyōken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu - Sekai Saikyō no Majutsushi de Aru Shōnen wa, Majutsu Gakuin ga Nyūgaku Suru ) light novel series on the same day.
